text:
The plate is a square plate roughly 26 cm across. It holds two corn cob pieces. One lies on its side and measures about 5 cm long and 4 cm across. The other is an end-on slice about 4 cm across and 2.5 cm tall. Each piece is roughly 40-50 g of kernels plus cob, so the two together come to about 90 g. A stray kernel adds a negligible amount. Boiled corn on the cob is about 95 kcal/100 g, counting the cob.
